exceptions.rationale: The invoice and bank deposit both show $70,387.52, but the general ledger shows $69,971.32, a shortfall of 41,620 cents.

The invoice is dated 2025-12-30, but the bill of lading shows all 317 units shipped on 2026-01-03, after year-end. The evidence does not support 2025 revenue recognition; the GL posting date was not provided.

judgments.rationale: The invoice bills 304 units, but the June 21 bill of lading shows 289 shipped. No shipment evidence was provided for the remaining 15 units ($4,294.05), even though the GL and deposit match the full invoice.
